note: The kit facts the game data's own text leaves out, by agent and ability, each with its kind, source, the patch it was verified on and who confirmed it. ability-facts.js reads it: an ability with bullets true gets the class bullets (so 'Contingency blocks bullets' passes and 'High Tide blocks bullets' is caught), one with bullets false is held to it, and one not listed is never judged on bullets. extra is appended to the ability's kit line after the game's own words. A fact with confirmed null is still sourced from more than one guide and stands until checked in game; re-stamp verifiedPatch after a patch that touches the agent (CLAUDE.md, primer.md).

Iso/Contingency.extra: The wall also blocks bullets from both sides, and players and abilities pass through it.
Iso/Contingency.source: Hotspawn, Full Iso Guide (the wall blocks incoming bullets while players and abilities pass through it); Red Bull, How to master Iso (it blocks bullets from both sides); Mobalytics, Iso guide.
